description:
Upcoming events on the Upper and High Rhine in Germany, France and
Switzerland, sorted by date and time: concerts and, where public, other
kinds (`kind` and `category` in each result: `concert`, `cabaret`,
`theater`, `show`, `spoken`, `kids`). A word for a kind or category in
`search` ("kabarett", "lesung", "konzert") filters by it. `region` is one of `basel` (Basel
and surroundings), `hochrhein` (High Rhine: Waldshut, Bad Säckingen,
Laufenburg, Zurzach), `freiburg` (Freiburg and southern Baden), `ortenau`,
`karlsruhe` (Karlsruhe and Baden-Baden) or `elsass` (Alsace: Mulhouse,
Colmar, Strasbourg, northern Alsace). All arguments are optional: `from`/`to` (dates),
`region`, `genre` and `search` (artist, venue, city, genre or region, in
German, French or English; several words narrow the result down, typos
and missing accents are tolerated). Times are in UTC; if the venue's `times_are_doors` is
true, the time is when doors open. At most 100 per call, page with
`limit` and `offset`. `page_url` is the link to give to users: the
concert's page on Trisonia, which also has the ticket link.

limit.description: The maximum number of records to return in one page

offset.description: The number of records to skip. Pass the `next_offset` from a previous page to fetch the following page.
